education.summary: The resistor sets the LED current. Without it the LED conducts almost uncontrolled and burns out.
objectives: Apply Ohm's law to size a series resistor
Read LED polarity from the symbol
education.theory: The LED drops roughly its forward voltage whatever the current, so the resistor takes the rest of the supply: R = (Vs − Vf) / I.
questions: What current flows here with a 5 V supply and Vf = 2 V?
What changes if the resistor is 1 kΩ instead?
experiments: Swap in 220 Ω, 1 kΩ and 10 kΩ and compare brightness.
troubleshooting: LED dark: check polarity first, then the resistor value.
